0022600153.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-1, 1st in the Northwest and 4th in the West, having lost their last game) visit the Houston Rockets (5-0, 1st in the Southwest and 1st in the West, on a five-game win streak), who still have one game to play before this one. The Thunder are without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while the Rockets are missing Alperen Sengun (back soreness), Reed Sheppard (back), and Steven Adams (calf strain). The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while Oklahoma City won the 2025-26 series 2-1, and the most recent meeting, on February 7, 2026 in Oklahoma City, ended with the Thunder losing 112-106.
